summary_markdown: The discussion focused on two specific, malfunctioning sensors at different facilities. The first sensor (JCD_BR-RIO-MD-08740) was found to be sending only empty packets. The second sensor (JCD_BR-RIO-MD-08659) exhibited poor correlation and discrepancies with local data. Both sensors were suspected of needing replacement or relocation/repositioning, as standard troubleshooting methods like updating firmware or rebooting did not resolve the issues.
decisions: The first problematic sensor needs investigation for potential replacement.
The second problematic sensor requires assessment for possible replacement or antenna repositioning.
action_items: Someone will attempt to update the sensors' firmware and assess the situation.
Someone will determine if the faulty sensors need physical replacement or relocation/repositioning of antennas.
